resources.string: EyeGuard accountability monitor for this TV. It checks that the screen can be seen, looks for explicit content on this TV with a detector that runs on the device, and reports its health to the family partners. A flagged picture is blurred and encrypted before it leaves the TV. In YouTube TV, YouTube and Jellyfin it also counts, without keeping or sending any text, whether a title is visible to it. It is set up and switched on by Jonah.
